mathematics.assertion_tested: 32 exact-form versus ODE comparisons for stable, marginal and unstable forced modes.

mathematics.conventions: Conditional source-eliminated repulsive condensate, Newtonian mean-subtracted periodic Poisson equation; no Lambda-CDM background. Dimensionless J=1 for simulations.
non_claims: No full two-field condensate preparation or source-elimination admission established.
No new metric law, empirical density, active pump, light coupling, or device.
Finite nonlinear cases do not prove all-amplitude global stability.
